source_local_demands.name: GSP message queues
source_local_demands.scope: Silicon defaults command256KiB + status256KiB +4096-byte PTE table. Status size accepts registry override; not a global bound.

source_local_demands.name: Turing boot argument descriptors
source_local_demands.scope: WPR metadata4096, LIBOS init args4096, GSP arguments4096. Zero-FB sysmem heap is a separate conditional allocation; no Zero-FB flag is fabricated.

source_local_demands.name: TU117 LIBOS logging selection
source_local_demands.scope: TU117 HAL selects LIBOS2. Baremetal task table accepts INIT and RM; other listed tasks are LIBOS3 only. Release defaults64KiB each; optional kernel log and registry overrides are separate.

source_local_demands.name: Firmware/external bindata descriptors
source_local_demands.scope: Bootloader image comes from actual bindata size, one signature descriptor, one image radix descriptor, optional external bindata radix descriptor. Their simultaneous lifetime depends on original phase.

source_local_demands.name: Trace crash buffer
source_local_demands.scope: Default50 NV_RATS_RECORD entries, clamped10..10000 on explicit override; one descriptor when enabled. Record size requires the exact original C profile.

source_local_demands.name: State monitor optional buffer
source_local_demands.scope: Always requests ALLOC_IN_UNPROTECTED_MEMORY. Current transport refuses unencrypted=true rather than claiming decryption. Original call uses NV_CHECK_OK and continues; optional-buffer failure must be reported and classified by the original-error audit.

why_no_global_32_record_proof: These local sites do not exhaust every original engine construction, RPC response, memory descriptor, large-page retry and shutdown allocation. A source-file count is not an allocation-lifetime trace.
Pinned firmware .fwimage size proves one concrete request fits; it does not bound other firmware/static-info-dependent allocations.
Registry log and queue overrides, optional external bindata and chip/config-dependent descriptors change demand. The intended profile must freeze relevant values before using a numeric peak claim.

GSP boot retries default to4 (nvrm_registry.h:2854; kernel_gsp.c:5712-5764), but safe release/reuse depends on exact failure phase and actual interrupt drain. Do not multiply a default static list and call it a global proof.

kernel_gsp.c:5351-5355 frees external bindata after INIT_DONE. osinit.c:2580-2630 releases RM resources before IRQ teardown, and engine destruction can precede late kgspUnload. Logical frees retain records/backing/IOVA until BOTH actual interrupt drain and accepted matching original hardware-DMA stop receipt.

runtime_observation.api: AbiStatistics abiStatistics(); capture before unbindRmDevice resets the completed binding.
runtime_observation.peak_scope: Successfully registered bound-RM allocation backing, including non-reusable retired records. Failed-constructor backend quarantines are not registered peak storage; failures remain separately reported.
runtime_observation.failure_semantics: Exceeding a record/page/byte budget never fabricates ownership or recycles a retirement. Preserve original allocation/PTE output and exact error; retain failed cleanup owners.
runtime_observation.first_hardware_attempt_precondition: Status-preserving original initialization failure and complete real adapter/GSP/IRQ/DMA teardown, or explicit persistent quarantine owner. The active ten-overlay original profile has no DMA stop receipt issuer and remains gated. This audit alone does not authorize hardware execution.
